mapper.select: select id, box_id, box_code, box_serial_number, box_per_number, item_code, product_name, wms_spec, net_weight, gross_weight, axle_load, total_net_weight, total_gross_weight, material_number, batch_number, batch_number2, weigh_time, wms_unit, inbound_status, installation_id, installation_status, installation_code, axis_serial_number, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark, material_code, artt1, artt2, artt3, artt4, trader, material_manufacturer, product_unique_code from wms_weigh_record where id = #{id}

SELECT MAX(box_code) AS box_code, MAX(box_serial_number) AS box_serial_number, MAX(axis_serial_number) AS axis_serial_number FROM wms_weigh_record WHERE DATE(create_time) = CURDATE() and create_by=#{username}
where DATE(create_time) = DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY) and artt2=0 and create_by = #{createBy}

SELECT t1.batch_number2, t1.gross_weight, t1.ss_time, CASE WHEN t1.gross_weight BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end} THEN '合格' ELSE '不合格' END AS quality_status, CONCAT(ROUND(t2.qualified_percentage, 2), '%') AS qualified_rate, t1.id FROM ( SELECT batch_number2, gross_weight, create_time AS ss_time, -- 直接使用原始 create_time，包含完整时分秒 id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY batch_number2, gross_weight, DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%H:00:00') ORDER BY create_time DESC ) AS rn FROM wms_weigh_record WHERE product_name IN ('镀锡线', '裸铜线') AND wms_spec = #{wmsSpec} AND DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') = #{date} ) t1 JOIN ( SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%H:00:00') AS hour_start, (COUNT(CASE WHEN gross_weight BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end} THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*)) AS qualified_percentage FROM wms_weigh_record WHERE product_name IN ('镀锡线', '裸铜线') AND wms_spec = #{wmsSpec} AND DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') = #{date} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%H:00:00') ) t2 ON DATE_FORMAT(t1.ss_time, '%H:00:00') = t2.hour_start WHERE t1.rn = 1 ORDER BY t1.ss_time;

SELECT t1.batch_number2, t1.gross_weight, t1.ss_time, CASE WHEN t1.gross_weight BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end} THEN '合格' ELSE '不合格' END AS quality_status, CONCAT(ROUND(t2.qualified_percentage, 2), '%') AS qualified_rate, t1.id FROM ( SELECT batch_number2, gross_weight, create_time AS ss_time, -- 返回完整时间戳 id FROM wms_weigh_record WHERE product_name IN ('镀锡线', '裸铜线') AND wms_spec = #{wmsSpec} AND DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m') = #{date} GROUP BY batch_number2, gross_weight, id, create_time -- 按完整时间戳分组，确保唯一性 ) t1 CROSS JOIN ( SELECT (COUNT(CASE WHEN gross_weight BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end} THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*)) AS qualified_percentage FROM wms_weigh_record WHERE product_name IN ('镀锡线', '裸铜线') AND wms_spec = #{wmsSpec} AND DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m') = #{date} ) t2 ORDER BY t1.ss_time;

SELECT t1.batch_number2, t1.gross_weight, t1.ss_time, CASE WHEN t1.gross_weight BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end} THEN '合格' ELSE '不合格' END AS quality_status, COALESCE(CONCAT(ROUND(t2.qualified_percentage, 2), '%'), '0%') AS qualified_rate, t1.id FROM ( SELECT batch_number2, gross_weight, create_time AS ss_time, id, DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%m') AS month FROM wms_weigh_record WHERE product_name IN ('镀锡线', '裸铜线') AND wms_spec = #{wmsSpec} AND DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y') = #{date} GROUP BY batch_number2, gross_weight, id, create_time ) t1 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%m') AS month_start, (COUNT(CASE WHEN gross_weight BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end} AND gross_weight IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0)) AS qualified_percentage FROM wms_weigh_record WHERE product_name IN ('镀锡线', '裸铜线') AND wms_spec = #{wmsSpec} AND DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y') = #{date} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%m') ) t2 ON t1.month = t2.month_start ORDER BY t1.ss_time;
